$comment: Integration record of the four authorized PhoneUse-derived improvements (device reservations, durable action outcomes, verified field input, useful UI-tree observations) plus the baseline qualification fix. Evidence is offline fixtures, a loopback WebDriverAgent double and isolated temporary homes with device/transport/paid-client helpers trapped. Nothing here was run on, or qualifies, a physical device, and nothing was packaged, installed, pushed or published.

durable_action_outcomes.participating: request_id and reservation_token on runtime.input, runtime.gesture, runtime.actions, screen.tap, android.input, testing.action, ios.emulator.control input
durable_action_outcomes.behaviour: identity + SHA-256 of canonical arguments committed (synchronous FULL) before dispatch; runtime worker records each delivered input as a child; same intent answers the recorded outcome (retained true, replayed false), changed arguments request_conflict, live executor request_in_progress, dead executor or lost answer unknown -> request_outcome_unknown, never resent through any session or transport; single-input requests reconciled from the worker child record
durable_action_outcomes.statuses: applied, verified, refused (provably nothing dispatched; repeatable), failed, unknown
durable_action_outcomes.verified_fill_mapping: field_uncertain and batches with uncertain_steps -> unknown; fill_verification_unsupported -> refused; field_not_focused/field_wrong_target/field_unsupported/field_stale/field_unobservable -> failed (focusing tap reached the device); field_submit_not_sent -> failed with the step in applied_steps; WDA details.delivery not_sent -> refused, unknown -> unknown
durable_action_outcomes.privacy_and_bounds: no typed text (character counts; stored answers scrub text/value strings) and no token; 24 h retention, at most 20000 rows, 64 KiB per stored answer; owner-only TOMACCO_HOME/coordination
durable_action_outcomes.not_claimed: not exactly-once: a transport that loses an answer leaves the effect unknown; only observation decides

verified_field_input.contract: fill with verify_value in runtime.input and runtime.actions; plain fill unchanged
verified_field_input.checks: focused editor covers the tapped point or matches field_name; supported text classes only; value read before (already-matching is not retyped; placeholder never taken as entered text); one clear/write; exact code-point read-back on the same element; submit only after verification while focus remains
verified_field_input.transports: USB iPhone over WebDriverAgent (contract-tested against a loopback double only) and scripted fixtures; Android, Apple Simulator and AirPlay advertise fill_verification supported:false and answer fill_verification_unsupported without sending anything, not even the tap
verified_field_input.limits: autocorrect/IME/formatters and NFC/NFD normalisation read back as field_uncertain (never retyped); web editors reported as XCUIElementTypeOther are unsupported; WDA attribute names are the double's assumption until run on a real iPhone

useful_observations.contract: screen.tree mode tree (default, unchanged) | compact | detail; query, refs, digest; every mode answers digest; a stale digest answers tree_stale before anything else
useful_observations.compact: deterministic whole-record selection from the entire tree within max_chars (focus/editors/query, controls/stateful/scroll, text, off-screen last; band rotation; repetition demotion); static labels folded into their single owning control with from= provenance, independent widgets and scroll regions not folded; original nN reference, mark number, bounds and state kept; omitted/omitted_refs/omitted_by explicit; password text never printed
useful_observations.detail: complete records per reference, password text withheld
useful_observations.measurement: fixture-only (lane B docs/input-observation-progress.json); compact keeps controls the document-order tree loses at small budgets and is about 7-10% longer when the whole tree fits; no token or performance claim

observations_for_root: Pre-existing, not changed here: the guard audit log (native/guard/audit.rs) records a `text` argument as its byte length and SHA-256, so a short secret typed with fill/text (a PIN) is recoverable from the audit log by brute force. The request ledger stores neither text nor digest. Changing the audit format is a public-contract decision outside this integration.
Root's CTest control-plane runs all modules in one discover process; this record's sweep ran them one per process.
